title: octarrhena brassii
intro: Octarrhena brassii, commonly known as the Brassi's orchid, is a species of orchid native to Papua New Guinea. As a traditional medicinal plant, it is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Octarrhena brassii include its use as an expectorant to relieve congestion, as well as its ability to reduce fever and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
